About The Role
 In this role, you will work as a Lead Full-Stack Java Engineer on large-scale enterprise systems supporting grants and external expert management within a European public-sector environment. You will combine hands-on full-stack development with technical leadership, ensuring that the team follows architecture, coding, quality, security, and delivery standards across complex distributed systems and cloud-based environments.
 Responsibilities
Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications
Design responsive user interfaces, APIs, business logic, and database integrations
Build and secure RESTful APIs and web services
Apply security best practices for validation, authentication, authorization, storage, logging, and monitoring
Perform unit and integration testing, debugging, and production issue resolution
Deploy and manage applications using AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes
Maintain code quality, technical documentation, and scalable architecture
Lead technical delivery and ensure adherence to design, coding, quality, and architecture principles
Guide developers, review technical solutions, and support alignment across cross-functional teams
Contribute to large-scale Agile delivery and continuous improvement practices
 Requirements
Master’s-level university degree or equivalent with 15+ years of professional IT experience
Strong technical leadership experience as a Senior/Lead Developer or Architect
Advanced knowledge of Java 19/21/25, Node.js, and PHP backend stacks
Strong experience with Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Spring Cloud, Hibernate JPA, and REST APIs
Advanced knowledge of Jakarta EE/J2EE, EJB 3, CDI, JMS, and WebLogic 14
High proficiency with JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Angular, Vue, and Bootstrap
Experience with Webpack, Vite, Nx, and RxJS
Advanced experience designing and securing REST APIs with OpenAPI/Swagger
Very good knowledge of Apache Kafka
Knowledge of JAX-WS, JAXB, Protobuf, Camunda, Activiti, and BPMN 2
Strong experience with PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, schema design, and query optimization
Experience with Maven and Liquibase
Strong AWS cloud experience
Experience with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CaaS, Consul, and AWS VDI environments
Advanced Git expertise, including GitFlow and trunk-based development
Experience with GitLab, Bitbucket, and SVN
Experience with Hexagonal Architecture, microservices, and CQRS
Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT
Experience with Kibana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Micrometer, and distributed tracing
Very good knowledge of JUnit 4/5 and experience with Mockito, Vitest, and Playwright
Extensive experience with large-scale Agile delivery using Jira
Knowledge of Scrum, Scrum of Scrums, SAFe, and PM2-Agile
Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Amazon Q and Kiro, including review of AI-generated code
Strong analytical, risk assessment, communication, and technical decision-making skills
English or French proficiency at B2 level or higher
